items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: Because my brother Tom was telling me that Buttsy was crossing the street

ctx.x: Yeah. Do you know where he's living?

I don't know if he dead or what, Son. I mean, uh. Buttsy. Yes. No, Buttsy living. I know he is, because I was just down there four or five months ago. And I asked about New Orleans, but where he at. I don't know. I don't know where he lived. He lived there, I don't know. Because my brother Tom was telling me that Buttsy was crossing the street in front of him. He said, you know, Buttsy act like you're going crazy. I said, what's the matter? He said, he's crossing the street and he's crossing and he got right,…
